description: Fires when a move wins material. Variant chosen by side (user/opp) × whether the captured piece was uncontested (no defender) × whether the move was an actual capture.

fact_glossary.captured_piece_type: Piece type that was captured (or 'piece' as fallback)
fact_glossary.mover_is_user: true if the mover is the user
fact_glossary.uncontested: true when the capture is free (nothing was defending the target)
fact_glossary.is_capture: true when the move actually captured a piece (vs winning material through threats)

variants.user_no_capture: {played_san}. Wins material in the resulting line.
variants.opp_uncontested: {played_san}. Opponent grabs the {captured_piece_type} — nothing was defending it.
